youtube_description:
If I woke up 30 pounds heavier tomorrow, this is the exact 8-step plan I would follow to get my abs back in 90 days, in the order I would do it.

See what you'd look like with a six-pack, free:
https://absbyai.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=longform&utm_content=ro16-belly-fat-90-days

I went from about 200 pounds with no abs to 175 pounds with abs at 40. It took me far longer than it should have. This is how I would do it all over again, knowing what I know now:

1. Quit my job or take the longest vacation I could, and make fat loss the number one priority for 90 days.
2. Get a Zepbound prescription in the very first week (talk to your doctor first).
3. Work out first thing every morning, 7 days a week, even if it is only 10 to 15 minutes.
4. Use a meal prep service so every meal is portioned and the calories are on the label.
5. Track calories with AI by taking a picture of your food.
6. Eat at least 0.8 grams of protein per pound of body weight every day, so you keep your muscle.
7. Weigh yourself every morning and adjust calories using your 7-day average.
8. Make a plan to never do this again: keep weighing in, and cut right back if you gain 3 pounds.

Not medical advice. Talk to your doctor before you start any medication or change your diet.
